rv.q: Lushly lyrical and entirely earnest, this vivid new version of Edmond Rostand's romantic classic faithfully captures the passionate power and poignant themes of the timeless story.
It's utterly exquisite, perfectly judged from the flourish of the adaptation to the size of Adrian Lester's prosthetic nose.
It's jaw-dropping, breathtaking acting, in a staging as ugly-beautiful, tough and tender as its hero.
